tracedAction: Parallel state functions in South Lebanon and the Bekaa; social-service provision; military operations against Israel; militant infrastructure rebuilt during the ceasefire in violation of the agreement.
tracedActionAr: وظائف دولة موازية في جنوب لبنان والبقاع؛ تقديم خدمات اجتماعية؛ عمليات عسكرية ضد إسرائيل؛ وإعادة بناء بنية تحتية عسكرية خلال وقف إطلاق النار في انتهاك للاتفاق.
summary: Parallel state functions in South Lebanon and the Bekaa; social-service provision; military operations against Israel; militant infrastructure rebuilt during the ceasefire in violation of the agreement.
